description: This file defines React components for header icons and buttons used in a mobile app, including BackButton, LeftButton, RightButton, DarkBackButton, and HelpButton, with various icon options and navigation logic.

methods.name: BackButton
methods.description: Renders different icons based on props, used as a back or menu button.

methods.name: LeftButton
methods.description: Renders a left-side header button with various icon options and navigation actions.

methods.name: RightButton
methods.description: Renders a right-side header button with options like cart, dots, target, and password toggle.

methods.name: HelpButton
methods.description: Button that navigates to the Help screen.
